title: Veterinary Oxygen Carrier Evidence | Oxyglobin, HBOC & BHOC
description: Explore source-linked veterinary HBOC evidence: FDA Oxyglobin canine trial results, 236 indexed publications, and FDA/EMA regulatory records.
heading: Veterinary oxygen-carrier evidence.
lead: Historical Oxyglobin regulatory evidence and the wider veterinary oxygen-carrier literature are presented together, with the population, endpoint and source boundaries kept explicit.

spotlight.title: 95% treatment success vs 32% control
spotlight.detail: FDA efficacy population: 20/21 Oxyglobin-treated dogs achieved treatment success versus 9/28 untreated controls; p≤0.001.
spotlight.endpoint: Treatment success meant no need for additional oxygen-carrying support for 24 hours. This was not a survival endpoint.
spotlight.trial: Pivotal multicenter field trial: 64 client-owned anaemic dogs; 30 randomized to Oxyglobin and 34 to untreated control.

snapshot.title: 236 records. Built to be traceable.
snapshot.text: The veterinary index is a source-linked bibliography across 10 species/model groups. It is not a claim that all 236 records are veterinary treatment trials.
snapshot.scope: Indexed groups: canine 25 · feline 6 · equine 4 · porcine 38 · ovine 4 · rodent 39 · avian 18 · exotic/other 15 · human 89 · other/in vitro 21. Records may carry more than one species/model label; group counts must not be added to derive the 236 total.

note: Evidence boundaries: the 95% vs 32% result is the FDA-defined 24-hour treatment-success endpoint in the Oxyglobin efficacy population, not survival. Historical Oxyglobin approvals do not establish BHOC efficacy, BHOC regulatory approval, approval for other species, affiliation or endorsement.
